_note: Synthetic house playbooks for the demo. They hold the agency's standard steps, lead times and definition of done.

measurement_setup.summary: Tracking plan, MMP events, SKAN conversion values and install QA before any paid spend.
measurement_setup.lead_time: Live and QA'd at least 5 working days before paid campaigns go live.
steps: Agree the event taxonomy with the client product team
Configure new events in the MMP
Design and deploy the SKAN conversion value schema
Run test installs on iOS and Android and confirm attribution
acceptance_criteria: Event taxonomy signed off by the client
Test installs attributed correctly on iOS and Android
SKAN schema live in the MMP and documented

paid_social_ua.summary: Meta and TikTok app install campaigns.
paid_social_ua.lead_time: Campaigns built in draft 3 working days before go-live. Final creative needed 5 working days before go-live.
steps: Media plan with budget split by market and platform
Build campaigns in draft with naming convention
Go live and pace budget daily for the first two weeks
acceptance_criteria: Media plan and budget split approved by the client
Campaigns built in draft with the agreed naming convention
Tracking links QA'd against the MMP before go-live

apple_search_ads.summary: Apple Search Ads campaigns: brand, category, competitor and discovery.
apple_search_ads.lead_time: Campaigns built 3 working days before go-live. Needs the final store listing and keywords.
steps: Go live with the iOS launch
acceptance_criteria: Four campaign types built: brand, category, competitor, discovery
Keyword list aligned with the ASO keyword set
CPT bids set against the CPI target

ad_creative_production.summary: Static and video ad creative for paid channels.
ad_creative_production.lead_time: Concepts at least 3 weeks before go-live. Finals 5 working days before go-live, after client legal review.
steps: Production of the approved concepts in every platform format
acceptance_criteria: 3 concepts, each in the formats every platform needs
Passed client legal review
Files meet each platform's specs

localisation.summary: Transcreate finished assets for another language or market, not just translate them.
localisation.lead_time: 4 working days after the source-language finals, plus legal review of the localised version.
steps: Client legal review of the localised version
acceptance_criteria: Native-speaker review done
Localised version approved by client legal
Delivered in the same formats as the source assets

store_creatives.summary: App store screenshots and the app preview video.
store_creatives.lead_time: Final assets 7 working days before store submission.
steps: Screenshot storyboard aligned with the ASO keyword themes
acceptance_criteria: Screenshots for every required device size
Preview video within the store's length limits
Approved by client legal

aso_refresh.summary: Keywords, title, subtitle and store listing per market.
aso_refresh.lead_time: Store submission at least 3 working days before launch so app review cannot block it.
steps: Title, subtitle and keyword field per market
acceptance_criteria: Keyword set agreed with the client
Listing live or approved in every market in scope
Store creatives uploaded

press_release.lead_time: Final release approved by client legal 5 working days before distribution.
acceptance_criteria: Approved by the client and client legal
Spokesperson quote approved
Distribution list and timing confirmed

media_briefings.summary: Embargoed briefings with target media so coverage lands on launch day.
media_briefings.lead_time: Briefings 5 to 10 working days before launch. Embargo lifts on launch day.
acceptance_criteria: Target list approved by the client
Briefings booked before the embargo window opens
Spokesperson briefing pack delivered

creator_partnerships.summary: Creator shortlist, contracts, briefs, content approval and disclosure.
creator_partnerships.lead_time: Contracts signed 15 working days before content goes live.
acceptance_criteria: Signed budget before outreach starts
Every post carries #ad or the platform's paid-partnership label
Content approved by client legal before it goes live

landing_page.summary: Launch landing page: copy, design and build, with SEO input from Organic.
landing_page.lead_time: Live 2 working days before launch. Copy needs legal review.
acceptance_criteria: Store badges deep-link to the right store per device
Page passes mobile QA
Claims approved by client legal

seo_content.summary: SEO articles that support the launch.
seo_content.lead_time: Briefs 3 weeks before publishing. Drafts need legal review.
acceptance_criteria: Each article targets an agreed keyword
Approved by client legal
Linked from the landing page

organic_social.summary: Launch content calendar and community management for the launch window.
organic_social.lead_time: Calendar approved 5 working days before launch.
acceptance_criteria: Calendar approved by the client
Reply guidelines agreed for launch week

ratings_reviews.summary: Protect the app store rating during launch: review monitoring, replies, in-app rating prompt timing.
steps: In-app rating prompt timing agreed with the client
acceptance_criteria: Rating tracked daily from launch
Replies to negative reviews within one working day

launch_reporting.summary: Live dashboard, weekly reports and the campaign wrap report.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard live on launch day with installs, CPI and D7 retention by market
Weekly report every Monday
Wrap report measures every KPI in the brief
